SAFETY DATA SHEET
Product name: KARRA CLEAN Solvent Wash 5L
Brightwell Coatings Pty Ltd (fictional example)
Issue date: 14 March 2023   Revision: 3.1

SECTION 1: Identification
Product identifier: KARRA CLEAN Solvent Wash
Recommended use: Cleaning solvent for tools and surfaces.
Supplier: Brightwell Coatings Pty Ltd, 12 Example Street, Exampleville
Emergency telephone number: 1800 555 0142 (24 hours)
Poisons Information Centre: 13 11 26

SECTION 2: Hazards identification
GHS classification: Flammable liquid Category 2; Eye irritation Category 2A; Specific target organ toxicity single exposure Category 3 (drowsiness).
Signal word: DANGER
Hazard statements: H225 Highly flammable liquid and vapour. H319 Causes serious eye irritation. H336 May cause drowsiness or dizziness.
Precautionary statements: P210 Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, open flames. P233 Keep container tightly closed. P305+P351+P338 IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes.
Poisons Standard (SUSMP): Not scheduled.

SECTION 3: Composition
Ethanol  64-17-5  60-80 %
Propan-2-ol  67-63-0  10-30 %

SECTION 4: First aid measures
Eyes: rinse with water. Swallowed: do not induce vomiting, call a doctor.

SECTION 5: Fire fighting measures
Use alcohol resistant foam, CO2, dry chemical. Hazchem code: •3YE

SECTION 6: Accidental release measures
Remove ignition sources. Absorb with inert material.

SECTION 7: Handling and storage
Store in a cool, well ventilated place away from ignition sources. Keep lids on containers.

SECTION 8: Exposure controls
Use local exhaust ventilation. Wear safety glasses and chemical resistant gloves.

SECTION 9: Physical and chemical properties
Appearance: clear liquid. Flash point: 14 C.

SECTION 14: Transport information
14.1 UN number: 1993
14.2 Proper shipping name: FLAMMABLE LIQUID, N.O.S. (ethanol, propan-2-ol)
14.3 Transport hazard class: Class 3
14.4 Packing group: II
Hazchem code: 3 YE
Subsidiary risk: None allocated

SECTION 16: Other information
Reference number 1203 in the supplier's internal catalogue. Prepared 2 February 2023.
